Name: Quacker's Vincent Portraits
Author: BlueQuacker
Description:
[center][img width=305]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54139/54139-1792362533-915101395.png[/img][/center]

I always thought Vincent's vanilla portraits looked a little odd (especially in comparison to Jas), and after looking through portrait mods I decided to just make one myself!

This mod tries to stay close to the general artstyle of Stardew, only changing his facial structure a little so it fits with all the other portraits in-game. I changed all 4 expressions for both his base outfit and his winter outfit.

Of course, this mod isn't compatible with other mods that change Vincent's portraits. There's a setting to enable or disable the mod if needed.
